headline: O003 does not load on the current runtime, so neither of its two decode baselines is reproducible

the_disagreement.note: the directive's handoff snapshot carries 87.67 as the physical reference, and the 56.5% bandwidth utilisation that G007 is defined against is computed from it. Only one of the two receipts states a method.

root_cause.error: ValueError: Received 27 parameters not in model: language_model.model.layers.<N>.self_attn.kv_b_proj.weight
root_cause.mechanism: mlx_lm 0.31.3's kimi_vl.py takes its attention from deepseek_v3.py, whose sanitizer DOES consume kv_b_proj -- it splits each into embed_q and unembed_out. But that sanitizer builds its prefix as 'model.layers.{l}.self_attn' while the Kimi-VL checkpoint stores 'language_model.model.layers.{l}.self_attn.kv_b_proj.weight'. kimi_vl.py's own sanitizer knows the language_model. prefix -- it uses it to stack experts -- but never applies the kv_b_proj split under it. The 27 tensors are never split, never consumed, and load_weights rejects them as extras.
verified_by: grep: kimi_vl.py contains ZERO mentions of kv_b_proj
count: exactly 27, one per text layer, matching the error

consequence: BOTH O003 physical baselines were produced under an earlier mlx_lm and neither can be re-measured on this runtime without the shim or a pinned version. A campaign whose physical reference number cannot be reproduced does not have a physical reference number -- it has a memory of one.

fix.what: a LOADER SHIM, not a patch to the vendored package. split_kv_b_proj() applies deepseek_v3's exact split -- reshape to (num_heads, qk_nope_head_dim + v_head_dim, -1), first qk_nope rows transposed as embed_q, the rest as unembed_out -- under the prefix the checkpoint actually uses. mlx_lm is untouched.
fix.refuses: raises when it matches nothing, so a future layout change cannot make it silently a no-op
fix.verified: 27 kv_b_proj -> 0 after the split; model.load_weights then accepts the checkpoint

scar: A PHYSICAL BASELINE IS ONLY AS DURABLE AS ITS RUNTIME. Pin the runtime version in every physical receipt, or the number becomes unreproducible the next time a vendor package reorganises a weight layout. Neither O003 receipt records its mlx_lm version.
